title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go; parity fixes; bump v1.113.0
author: Samuel Park
release_notes: SDKs: unify auth/retry config APIs and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go. Parity fixes for streaming reconnect behavior and consistent default retry policy. Bumped SDK package versions to v1.113.0.
description: Motivation: multiple SDKs had diverging auth/retry ergonomics and small differences in streaming semantics which caused integration headaches for customers and internal services. This PR unifies the public surface and default behaviour across Python, TypeScript, and Go: 1) Consolidated retry policy shape (max_attempts, backoff_strategy, jitter) and central implementation in sdk/common/retries so language bindings share semantics. 2) Auth helpers standardized: credential refresh hooks and explicit token provider interface (auth -> token_provider) to support long-running streams. 3) Streaming ergonomics: improved reconnect/backoff logic, consistent on_chunk vs on_message callbacks, and added explicit stream.close() semantics to avoid silent resource leaks. 4) Parity fixes: addressed small behavioral differences (TS emitted an extra EOF on network hiccups; Python did not propagate transient 429 as retriable; Go didn't honor max_attempts for certain unary calls). 5) Version bumps: Python/TS/Go packages bumped to v1.113.0 and changelogs updated. Summary of work: reorganized retry implementation into sdk/common/retries, added language wrappers (python: redwood/retries.py; ts: src/retries.ts; go: retries/config.go), updated auth modules (python: client auth factory; ts: auth.ts; go: client auth provider), improved streaming core (python: streaming.StreamClient; ts: StreamingClient; go: client/stream.go), tests added for reconnect and retry edge cases across all three SDKs, updated docs and migration notes. CI notes: initial CI run failed on go vet and typescript lint; fixed formatting and tightened types. All tests pass in final run. Related: ENG-1219 (retry spec), ENG-1227 (streaming reliability), SUP-438 (customer incident from 2026-01-25).
